newsitem.title: USA: Chesapeake Energy files for 3.25 mln common.
newsitem.headline: Chesapeake Energy files for 3.25 mln common.

text.p: Chesapeake Energy Corp filed Monday with the Securities and Exchange Commission for up to 3.25 million common shares.
The company said net proceeds will be used to reduce debt, fund expanded exploration and production expenditures and for general corporate purposes.
The offering will be made by an underwriters' group led by Donaldson, Lufkin & Jenrette Securities Corp. The underwriters have an over-allotment option for up to 487,500 additional shares.
Chesapeake is an Oklahoma City, Okla.,-based independent oil and natural gas exploration and production company.
